title: Terms of Service
subtitle: Simple rules so everyone can have fun safely.

s1.title: A simulation entertainment service
s1.body: Zamrud Play is simulation entertainment. All balances and results are virtual, have no monetary value, and cannot be cashed out, purchased, transferred or traded.

s2.title: Eligibility
s2.body: You must be 18 or over and provide accurate account information. One person, one account.

s3.title: Prohibited conduct
s3.body: Do not tamper with requests to change balances or results, exploit bugs, use bots, disrupt the service, or try to access other players' data.

s4.title: Game fairness
s4.body: Results are decided by the server under published rules that are identical for all players. Admins may publish new rules versions; a round in progress keeps its rules.

s5.title: Availability & demo data
s5.body: The service is provided as is. In demo environments, data may be reset at any time.

s6.title: Account suspension
s6.body: We may suspend accounts that violate these terms. Every suspension is recorded with its reason.

s7.title: Limitation of liability
s7.body: Because no monetary value is involved, we are not liable for loss of virtual coins. We work to keep the service reliable and secure.

s8.title: Changes to these terms
s8.body: Terms may be updated; material changes are announced in the app.
